CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.feya_fn_content_jaccard_v1(p_left text[], p_right text[])
 RETURNS numeric
 LANGUAGE sql
 IMMUTABLE
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
  with inter as (
    select count(*)::numeric as n
    from unnest(coalesce(p_left,array[]::text[])) t
    where t = any(coalesce(p_right,array[]::text[]))
  ),
  uni as (
    select count(*)::numeric as n
    from (
      select unnest(coalesce(p_left,array[]::text[])) as t
      union
      select unnest(coalesce(p_right,array[]::text[])) as t
    ) u
  )
  select case
    when uni.n = 0 then 0::numeric
    else inter.n / uni.n
  end
  from inter,uni;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.feya_fn_content_token_set_v1(p_text text)
 RETURNS text[]
 LANGUAGE sql
 IMMUTABLE
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
  select coalesce(
    array_agg(distinct token order by token),
    array[]::text[]
  )
  from regexp_split_to_table(
    regexp_replace(lower(coalesce(p_text,'')), '[^a-z0-9]+', ' ', 'g'),
    '\s+'
  ) as token
  where length(token) >= 3
    and token not in (
      'the','and','for','with','from','this','that','your','our',
      'are','was','were','has','have','had','not','but','into',
      'its','you','can','all','any','each','use','using'
    );
$function$

relations.definition:
WITH latest AS (
         SELECT c.cleanup_id,
            c.run_id,
            c.keyword_id,
            c.keyword_norm,
            c.original_keyword,
            c.cleaned_keyword,
            c.suggested_keyword,
            c.keyword_axis,
            c.keyword_pattern,
            c.suggested_page_level,
            c.ai_intent,
            c.ai_rewrite_status,
            c.should_validate_api,
            c.should_use_for_product,
            c.should_use_for_collection,
            c.should_use_for_image_alt,
            c.should_hold,
            c.warning_flags,
            c.ai_reason,
            c.model_name,
            c.prompt_version,
            c.source_queue_snapshot,
            c.raw_ai_response_json,
            c.review_status,
            c.approved_keyword,
            c.approved_keyword_norm,
            c.approved_at,
            c.approved_by,
            c.created_at,
            c.updated_at,
            row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY c.keyword_norm ORDER BY c.created_at DESC, c.cleanup_id DESC) AS rn
           FROM feya_commerce_seo_keyword_ai_cleanup_v1 c
          WHERE (c.review_status = 'pending'::text)
        ), prepared AS (
         SELECT l.cleanup_id,
            l.run_id,
            l.keyword_id,
            l.keyword_norm,
            l.original_keyword,
            l.cleaned_keyword,
            l.suggested_keyword,
            l.keyword_axis,
            l.keyword_pattern,
            l.suggested_page_level,
            l.ai_intent,
            l.ai_rewrite_status,
            l.should_validate_api,
            l.should_use_for_product,
            l.should_use_for_collection,
            l.should_use_for_image_alt,
            l.should_hold,
            l.warning_flags,
            l.ai_reason,
            l.model_name,
            l.prompt_version,
            l.source_queue_snapshot,
            l.raw_ai_response_json,
            l.review_status,
            l.approved_keyword,
            l.approved_keyword_norm,
            l.approved_at,
            l.approved_by,
            l.created_at,
            l.updated_at,
            l.rn,
            COALESCE(NULLIF(btrim(l.suggested_keyword), ''::text), NULLIF(btrim(l.cleaned_keyword), ''::text), NULLIF(btrim(l.original_keyword), ''::text)) AS effective_keyword,
            regexp_replace(lower(btrim(l.original_keyword)), '\s+'::text, ' '::text, 'g'::text) AS normalized_original,
            ((
                CASE
                    WHEN l.should_use_for_product THEN 1
                    ELSE 0
                END +
                CASE
                    WHEN l.should_use_for_collection THEN 1
                    ELSE 0
                END) +
                CASE
                    WHEN l.should_use_for_image_alt THEN 1
                    ELSE 0
                END) AS use_lane_count,
            (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
                   FROM jsonb_array_elements_text(l.warning_flags) w(flag)
                  WHERE (w.flag <> ALL (ARRAY['deterministic_cleanup_without_openai'::text, 'auto_filled_suggested_keyword_from_cleaned'::text, 'auto_normalized_unchanged_status'::text, 'auto_repaired_batch50_schema_drift'::text])))) AS has_nontechnical_warning,
            (l.warning_flags ? 'auto_repaired_batch50_schema_drift'::text) AS schema_drift_repair
           FROM latest l
          WHERE (l.rn = 1)
        )
 SELECT cleanup_id,
    keyword_id,
    keyword_norm,
    original_keyword,
    cleaned_keyword,
    suggested_keyword,
    effective_keyword,
    keyword_axis,
    keyword_pattern,
    suggested_page_level,
    ai_intent,
    ai_rewrite_status,
    should_validate_api,
    should_use_for_product,
    should_use_for_collection,
    should_use_for_image_alt,
    should_hold,
    warning_flags,
    ai_reason,
    model_name,
    prompt_version,
    created_at,
    (lower(effective_keyword) = normalized_original) AS normalization_only,
    use_lane_count,
        CASE
            WHEN should_hold THEN 'HIGH'::text
            WHEN (effective_keyword IS NULL) THEN 'HIGH'::text
            WHEN ((ai_intent IS NULL) OR (ai_intent = 'unclear'::text)) THEN 'HIGH'::text
            WHEN (use_lane_count <> 1) THEN 'HIGH'::text
            WHEN (suggested_page_level = 'image_alt'::text) THEN 'HIGH'::text
            WHEN schema_drift_repair THEN 'HIGH'::text
            WHEN has_nontechnical_warning THEN 'HIGH'::text
            WHEN (lower(effective_keyword) <> normalized_original) THEN 'HIGH'::text
            WHEN (suggested_page_level = 'collection'::text) THEN 'MEDIUM'::text
            WHEN ((suggested_page_level = 'product'::text) AND (ai_intent = ANY (ARRAY['transactional'::text, 'commercial'::text]))) THEN 'LOW'::text
            ELSE 'MEDIUM'::text
        END AS review_risk,
        CASE
            WHEN should_hold THEN 'HOLD_REVIEW'::text
            WHEN (effective_keyword IS NULL) THEN 'SEMANTIC_DEEP_REVIEW'::text
            WHEN ((ai_intent IS NULL) OR (ai_intent = 'unclear'::text)) THEN 'SEMANTIC_DEEP_REVIEW'::text
            WHEN (use_lane_count <> 1) THEN 'ROUTING_CONFLICT_REVIEW'::text
            WHEN (suggested_page_level = 'image_alt'::text) THEN 'IMAGE_ALT_REVIEW'::text
            WHEN schema_drift_repair THEN 'SCHEMA_REPAIR_REVIEW'::text
            WHEN has_nontechnical_warning THEN 'WARNING_REVIEW'::text
            WHEN (lower(effective_keyword) <> normalized_original) THEN 'SEMANTIC_REWRITE_REVIEW'::text
            WHEN (suggested_page_level = 'collection'::text) THEN 'COLLECTION_ROUTING_REVIEW'::text
            ELSE 'FAST_SEMANTIC_REVIEW'::text
        END AS review_lane
   FROM prepared p;

         SELECT DISTINCT ON (r.cleanup_id) r.cleanup_id,

 SELECT q.cleanup_id,
    q.keyword_id,

relations.name: feya_commerce_v_page_ownership_shortlist_v1
relations.definition:
WITH cluster_text AS (
         SELECT c.query_cluster_id,
            c.cluster_code,
            c.cluster_label,
            c.normalized_intent,
            c.intent_type,
            c.language_code,
            c.market_scope,
            feya_fn_content_token_set_v1(((c.normalized_intent || ' '::text) || COALESCE(( SELECT string_agg(m.keyword_norm, ' '::text) AS string_agg
                   FROM feya_commerce_seo_query_cluster_members_v1 m
                  WHERE ((m.query_cluster_id = c.query_cluster_id) AND (m.member_role <> 'excluded'::text))), ''::text))) AS cluster_tokens
           FROM feya_commerce_v_page_query_ownership_candidate_clusters_v1 c
          WHERE (c.ownership_candidate_status = 'READY_FOR_OWNERSHIP_PROPOSAL'::text)
        ), page_text AS (
         SELECT p.seo_page_id,
            p.page_type,
            p.canonical_product_id,
            p.url_path,
            p.market_code,
            p.locale,
            p.lifecycle_state,
            p.indexation_intent,
            p.protected_winner_flag,
            pd.card_title,
            pd.h1,
            pd.product_type,
            pd.material,
            pd.color,
            feya_fn_content_token_set_v1(((((((((COALESCE(pd.card_title, ''::text) || ' '::text) || COALESCE(pd.h1, ''::text)) || ' '::text) || COALESCE(pd.product_type, ''::text)) || ' '::text) || COALESCE(pd.material, ''::text)) || ' '::text) || COALESCE(pd.color, ''::text))) AS page_tokens
           FROM (feya_commerce_seo_pages_v1 p
             LEFT JOIN feya_commerce_product_drafts pd ON ((pd.canonical_product_id = p.canonical_product_id)))
          WHERE ((p.portfolio_status = 'active'::text) AND (p.indexation_intent = ANY (ARRAY['candidate'::text, 'indexable'::text])))
        ), scored AS (
         SELECT c.query_cluster_id,
            c.cluster_code,
            c.cluster_label,
            c.normalized_intent,
            c.intent_type,
            p.seo_page_id,
            p.page_type,
            p.canonical_product_id,
            p.url_path,
            p.market_code,
            p.locale,
            p.lifecycle_state,
            p.indexation_intent,
            p.protected_winner_flag,
            p.card_title,
            p.h1,
            p.product_type,
            p.material,
            p.color,
            feya_fn_content_jaccard_v1(c.cluster_tokens, p.page_tokens) AS lexical_overlap_score
           FROM (cluster_text c
             CROSS JOIN page_text p)
          WHERE ((p.market_code = 'US'::text) AND (p.locale = 'en-US'::text))
        ), ranked AS (
         SELECT s.query_cluster_id,
            s.cluster_code,
            s.cluster_label,
            s.normalized_intent,
            s.intent_type,
            s.seo_page_id,
            s.page_type,
            s.canonical_product_id,
            s.url_path,
            s.market_code,
            s.locale,
            s.lifecycle_state,
            s.indexation_intent,
            s.protected_winner_flag,
            s.card_title,
            s.h1,
            s.product_type,
            s.material,
            s.color,
            s.lexical_overlap_score,
            row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY s.query_cluster_id ORDER BY s.lexical_overlap_score DESC, s.url_path) AS shortlist_rank
           FROM scored s
          WHERE (s.lexical_overlap_score > (0)::numeric)
        )
 SELECT query_cluster_id,
    cluster_code,
    cluster_label,
    normalized_intent,
    intent_type,
    seo_page_id,
    page_type,
    canonical_product_id,
    url_path,
    market_code,
    locale,
    lifecycle_state,
    indexation_intent,
    protected_winner_flag,
    card_title,
    h1,
    product_type,
    material,
    color,
    lexical_overlap_score,
    shortlist_rank,
    'lexical_candidate_retrieval_not_ownership'::text AS shortlist_method
   FROM ranked r
  WHERE (shortlist_rank <= 20);

relations.name: feya_commerce_v_page_query_ownership_candidate_clusters_v1
relations.definition:
WITH primary_owner AS (
         SELECT o.query_cluster_id,
            (count(*))::integer AS primary_owner_count
           FROM feya_commerce_seo_page_query_ownership_v1 o
          WHERE ((o.ownership_role = 'primary'::text) AND (o.ownership_status = ANY (ARRAY['intended'::text, 'active'::text, 'protected'::text])) AND (o.effective_to IS NULL))
          GROUP BY o.query_cluster_id
        )
 SELECT c.query_cluster_id,
    c.cluster_code,
    c.cluster_label,
    c.normalized_intent,
    c.intent_type,
    c.language_code,
    c.market_scope,
    c.cluster_status,
    (count(m.query_cluster_member_id))::integer AS member_count,
    COALESCE(po.primary_owner_count, 0) AS primary_owner_count,
        CASE
            WHEN (c.cluster_status <> 'approved'::text) THEN 'NOT_READY'::text
            WHEN (COALESCE(po.primary_owner_count, 0) > 0) THEN 'OWNERSHIP_EXISTS'::text
            ELSE 'READY_FOR_OWNERSHIP_PROPOSAL'::text
        END AS ownership_candidate_status
   FROM ((feya_commerce_seo_query_clusters_v1 c
     LEFT JOIN feya_commerce_seo_query_cluster_members_v1 m ON (((m.query_cluster_id = c.query_cluster_id) AND (m.member_role <> 'excluded'::text))))
     LEFT JOIN primary_owner po ON ((po.query_cluster_id = c.query_cluster_id)))
  GROUP BY c.query_cluster_id, c.cluster_code, c.cluster_label, c.normalized_intent, c.intent_type, c.language_code, c.market_scope, c.cluster_status, po.primary_owner_count;

relations.name: feya_commerce_v_seo_api_validation_queue_v1
relations.definition:
SELECT keyword_id,
    keyword,
    keyword_norm,
    keyword_word_count,
    keyword_axis,
    keyword_pattern,
    product_count,
    suggested_page_level,
    priority_tier,
    validation_priority,
    validation_status,
    requires_api_validation,
    reason,
    source,
    first_seen_at,
    last_seen_at
   FROM feya_commerce_seo_keyword_master_v1 m
  WHERE ((active_flag IS TRUE) AND (validation_status = 'queued'::text) AND (requires_api_validation IS TRUE) AND (keyword_word_count >= 2) AND (validation_priority <> 'low'::text) AND (COALESCE(reason, ''::text) !~~* '%size phrase%'::text) AND (COALESCE(reason, ''::text) !~~* '%bundle option%'::text) AND (keyword_norm <> ALL (ARRAY['full set'::text, 'whole product'::text, 'choose your set'::text, 'полный комплект'::text])) AND (keyword_norm !~ '(^|[^a-z0-9])(xxs|xs|s us|m us|l us|xl|2x|3x|size|размер|буквенный)([^a-z0-9]|$)'::text) AND (NOT (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
           FROM feya_commerce_seo_keyword_compatibility_block_rules_v1 r
          WHERE ((r.active_flag IS TRUE) AND (m.keyword_norm ~ r.block_regex) AND ((r.allowed_regex IS NULL) OR (m.keyword_norm !~ r.allowed_regex)))))));

relations.definition:
WITH latest_cleanup AS (
         SELECT c.cleanup_id,
            c.run_id,

            c.suggested_keyword,

            c.created_at,
            c.updated_at,
            row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY c.keyword_norm ORDER BY c.created_at DESC, c.cleanup_id DESC) AS rn
           FROM feya_commerce_seo_keyword_ai_cleanup_v1 c
        ), queue_base AS (
         SELECT q.keyword_id,
            q.keyword,
            q.keyword_norm,
            q.keyword_word_count,
            q.keyword_axis,
            q.keyword_pattern,
            q.product_count,
            q.suggested_page_level,

            q.validation_priority,
            q.validation_status,
            q.requires_api_validation,
            q.reason,
            q.source,
            q.first_seen_at,
            q.last_seen_at
           FROM feya_commerce_v_seo_api_validation_queue_v1 q
        )
 SELECT qb.keyword_id,
    qb.keyword,
    qb.keyword_norm,
    qb.keyword_word_count,
    qb.keyword_axis AS queue_keyword_axis,
    qb.keyword_pattern AS queue_keyword_pattern,
    qb.product_count,
    qb.suggested_page_level AS queue_suggested_page_level,
    qb.priority_tier,
    qb.validation_priority,
    qb.validation_status,
    qb.requires_api_validation,
    qb.reason AS queue_reason,
    qb.source,
    lc.cleanup_id,
    lc.run_id,
    lc.cleaned_keyword,
    lc.suggested_keyword,
    lc.keyword_axis AS ai_keyword_axis,
    lc.keyword_pattern AS ai_keyword_pattern,
    lc.suggested_page_level AS ai_suggested_page_level,
    lc.ai_intent,
    lc.ai_rewrite_status,
    lc.should_validate_api,
    lc.should_use_for_product,
    lc.should_use_for_collection,
    lc.should_use_for_image_alt,
    lc.should_hold,
    lc.warning_flags,
    lc.ai_reason,
    lc.model_name,
    lc.prompt_version,
    lc.review_status,
    lc.approved_keyword,
    lc.approved_keyword_norm,
    lc.approved_at,
    lc.created_at AS cleanup_created_at,
        CASE
            WHEN (lc.cleanup_id IS NULL) THEN 'needs_ai_cleanup'::text
            WHEN (lc.review_status = ANY (ARRAY['pending'::text, 'needs_review'::text])) THEN 'needs_human_review'::text
            WHEN lc.should_hold THEN 'hold'::text
            WHEN lc.should_validate_api THEN 'ready_for_metric_validation'::text
            ELSE 'cleaned_no_validation'::text
        END AS cleanup_pipeline_status
   FROM (queue_base qb
     LEFT JOIN latest_cleanup lc ON (((lc.keyword_norm = qb.keyword_norm) AND (lc.rn = 1))));

relations.name: feya_commerce_v_seo_keyword_metric_import_ready_v1
relations.definition:
SELECT s.import_row_id,
    s.batch_code,
    COALESCE(s.keyword, m.keyword) AS keyword,
    regexp_replace(lower(btrim(COALESCE(s.keyword_norm, s.keyword, ''::text))), '\s+'::text, ' '::text, 'g'::text) AS keyword_norm,
    s.geo,
    s.language,
    s.avg_monthly_searches,
        CASE
            WHEN (s.competition IS NULL) THEN NULL::text
            WHEN (lower(s.competition) = 'низкая'::text) THEN 'LOW'::text
            WHEN (lower(s.competition) = 'средняя'::text) THEN 'MEDIUM'::text
            WHEN (lower(s.competition) = 'высокая'::text) THEN 'HIGH'::text
            ELSE upper(s.competition)
        END AS competition,
    s.competition_index,
    s.low_top_of_page_bid,
    s.high_top_of_page_bid,
    s.monthly_search_volumes_raw,
    s.source_file_name,
    s.imported_at,
    s.import_status,
    s.import_note
   FROM ((feya_commerce_seo_keyword_metric_import_staging_v1 s
     JOIN feya_commerce_seo_keyword_master_v1 m ON (((m.keyword_norm = regexp_replace(lower(btrim(COALESCE(s.keyword_norm, s.keyword, ''::text))), '\s+'::text, ' '::text, 'g'::text)) AND (m.active_flag IS TRUE))))
     JOIN feya_commerce_v_seo_keyword_validation_export_us_en_v1 e ON (((e.keyword_norm = m.keyword_norm) AND (e.batch_code = s.batch_code) AND (e.geo = s.geo) AND (e.language = s.language))))
  WHERE ((NULLIF(regexp_replace(lower(btrim(COALESCE(s.keyword_norm, s.keyword, ''::text))), '\s+'::text, ' '::text, 'g'::text), ''::text) IS NOT NULL) AND (NOT ((s.avg_monthly_searches IS NULL) AND (s.competition IS NULL) AND (s.competition_index IS NULL))) AND ((s.avg_monthly_searches IS NULL) OR (s.avg_monthly_searches >= 0)) AND ((s.competition IS NULL) OR (lower(s.competition) = ANY (ARRAY['low'::text, 'medium'::text, 'high'::text, 'unknown'::text, 'низкая'::text, 'средняя'::text, 'высокая'::text]))));

relations.name: feya_commerce_v_seo_keyword_metric_import_validation_report_v1
relations.definition:
WITH staging AS (
         SELECT s.import_row_id,
            s.batch_code,
            s.keyword,
            s.keyword_norm,
            s.geo,
            s.language,
            s.avg_monthly_searches,
            s.competition,
            s.competition_index,
            s.low_top_of_page_bid,
            s.high_top_of_page_bid,
            s.monthly_search_volumes_raw,
            s.source_file_name,
            s.imported_at,
            s.import_status,
            s.import_note,
            s.created_at,
            regexp_replace(lower(btrim(COALESCE(s.keyword_norm, s.keyword, ''::text))), '\s+'::text, ' '::text, 'g'::text) AS keyword_norm_clean,
            m.keyword_id,
            m.keyword AS master_keyword,
            m.validation_status AS master_validation_status,
            m.priority_tier AS master_priority_tier,
            m.validation_priority AS master_validation_priority,
            e.keyword_norm AS export_keyword_norm
           FROM ((feya_commerce_seo_keyword_metric_import_staging_v1 s
             LEFT JOIN feya_commerce_seo_keyword_master_v1 m ON (((m.keyword_norm = regexp_replace(lower(btrim(COALESCE(s.keyword_norm, s.keyword, ''::text))), '\s+'::text, ' '::text, 'g'::text)) AND (m.active_flag IS TRUE))))
             LEFT JOIN feya_commerce_v_seo_keyword_validation_export_us_en_v1 e ON (((e.keyword_norm = regexp_replace(lower(btrim(COALESCE(s.keyword_norm, s.keyword, ''::text))), '\s+'::text, ' '::text, 'g'::text)) AND (e.batch_code = s.batch_code) AND (e.geo = s.geo) AND (e.language = s.language))))
        ), row_checks AS (
         SELECT staging.import_row_id,
            staging.batch_code,
            staging.keyword,
            staging.keyword_norm,
            staging.geo,
            staging.language,
            staging.avg_monthly_searches,
            staging.competition,
            staging.competition_index,
            staging.low_top_of_page_bid,
            staging.high_top_of_page_bid,
            staging.monthly_search_volumes_raw,
            staging.source_file_name,
            staging.imported_at,
            staging.import_status,
            staging.import_note,
            staging.created_at,
            staging.keyword_norm_clean,
            staging.keyword_id,
            staging.master_keyword,
            staging.master_validation_status,
            staging.master_priority_tier,
            staging.master_validation_priority,
            staging.export_keyword_norm,
                CASE
                    WHEN (NULLIF(staging.keyword_norm_clean, ''::text) IS NULL) THEN 'invalid_empty_keyword_norm'::text
                    WHEN (staging.keyword_id IS NULL) THEN 'not_matched_to_keyword_master'::text
                    WHEN (staging.export_keyword_norm IS NULL) THEN 'not_in_expected_export_batch'::text
                    WHEN ((staging.avg_monthly_searches IS NULL) AND (staging.competition IS NULL) AND (staging.competition_index IS NULL)) THEN 'missing_metrics'::text
                    WHEN ((staging.competition IS NOT NULL) AND (lower(staging.competition) <> ALL (ARRAY['low'::text, 'medium'::text, 'high'::text, 'unknown'::text, 'низкая'::text, 'средняя'::text, 'высокая'::text]))) THEN 'competition_value_needs_review'::text
                    WHEN ((staging.avg_monthly_searches IS NOT NULL) AND (staging.avg_monthly_searches < 0)) THEN 'negative_volume_invalid'::text
                    ELSE 'ready_for_snapshot'::text
                END AS validation_result,
                CASE
                    WHEN (staging.keyword_id IS NULL) THEN true
                    WHEN (staging.export_keyword_norm IS NULL) THEN true
                    WHEN ((staging.avg_monthly_searches IS NULL) AND (staging.competition IS NULL) AND (staging.competition_index IS NULL)) THEN true
                    WHEN ((staging.competition IS NOT NULL) AND (lower(staging.competition) <> ALL (ARRAY['low'::text, 'medium'::text, 'high'::text, 'unknown'::text, 'низкая'::text, 'средняя'::text, 'высокая'::text]))) THEN true
                    WHEN ((staging.avg_monthly_searches IS NOT NULL) AND (staging.avg_monthly_searches < 0)) THEN true
                    ELSE false
                END AS needs_manual_review
           FROM staging
        ), summary AS (
         SELECT 'summary'::text AS section,
            'imported_rows'::text AS metric,
            NULL::text AS batch_code,
            NULL::text AS keyword,
            NULL::text AS keyword_norm,
            count(*) AS row_count,
            NULL::text AS validation_result,
            NULL::boolean AS needs_manual_review
           FROM row_checks
        UNION ALL
         SELECT 'summary'::text,
            'matched_to_keyword_master'::text,
            NULL::text,
            NULL::text,
            NULL::text,
            count(*) FILTER (WHERE (row_checks.keyword_id IS NOT NULL)) AS count,
            NULL::text,
            NULL::boolean
           FROM row_checks
        UNION ALL
         SELECT 'summary'::text,
            'not_matched_to_keyword_master'::text,
            NULL::text,
            NULL::text,
            NULL::text,
            count(*) FILTER (WHERE (row_checks.keyword_id IS NULL)) AS count,
            NULL::text,
            NULL::boolean
           FROM row_checks
        UNION ALL
         SELECT 'summary'::text,
            'ready_for_snapshot'::text,
            NULL::text,
            NULL::text,
            NULL::text,
            count(*) FILTER (WHERE (row_checks.validation_result = 'ready_for_snapshot'::text)) AS count,
            NULL::text,
            NULL::boolean
           FROM row_checks
        UNION ALL
         SELECT 'summary'::text,
            'missing_metrics'::text,
            NULL::text,
            NULL::text,
            NULL::text,
            count(*) FILTER (WHERE (row_checks.validation_result = 'missing_metrics'::text)) AS count,
            NULL::text,
            NULL::boolean
           FROM row_checks
        UNION ALL
         SELECT 'summary'::text,
            'competition_value_needs_review'::text,
            NULL::text,
            NULL::text,
            NULL::text,
            count(*) FILTER (WHERE (row_checks.validation_result = 'competition_value_needs_review'::text)) AS count,
            NULL::text,
            NULL::boolean
           FROM row_checks
        UNION ALL
         SELECT 'summary'::text,
            'needs_manual_review'::text,
            NULL::text,
            NULL::text,
            NULL::text,
            count(*) FILTER (WHERE (row_checks.needs_manual_review IS TRUE)) AS count,
            NULL::text,
            NULL::boolean
           FROM row_checks
        ), detail AS (
         SELECT 'detail'::text AS section,
            COALESCE(row_checks.validation_result, 'unknown'::text) AS metric,
            row_checks.batch_code,
            COALESCE(row_checks.keyword, row_checks.master_keyword) AS keyword,
            row_checks.keyword_norm_clean AS keyword_norm,
            NULL::bigint AS row_count,
            row_checks.validation_result,
            row_checks.needs_manual_review
           FROM row_checks
        )
 SELECT summary.section,
    summary.metric,
    summary.batch_code,
    summary.keyword,
    summary.keyword_norm,
    summary.row_count,
    summary.validation_result,
    summary.needs_manual_review
   FROM summary
UNION ALL
 SELECT detail.section,
    detail.metric,
    detail.batch_code,
    detail.keyword,
    detail.keyword_norm,
    detail.row_count,
    detail.validation_result,
    detail.needs_manual_review
   FROM detail;

relations.name: feya_commerce_v_seo_keyword_metric_validation_queue_v1
relations.definition:
WITH latest_cleanup AS (
         SELECT c_1.cleanup_id,
            c_1.run_id,
            c_1.keyword_id,
            c_1.keyword_norm,
            c_1.original_keyword,
            c_1.cleaned_keyword,
            c_1.suggested_keyword,
            c_1.keyword_axis,
            c_1.keyword_pattern,
            c_1.suggested_page_level,
            c_1.ai_intent,
            c_1.ai_rewrite_status,
            c_1.should_validate_api,
            c_1.should_use_for_product,
            c_1.should_use_for_collection,
            c_1.should_use_for_image_alt,
            c_1.should_hold,
            c_1.warning_flags,
            c_1.ai_reason,
            c_1.model_name,
            c_1.prompt_version,
            c_1.source_queue_snapshot,
            c_1.raw_ai_response_json,
            c_1.review_status,
            c_1.approved_keyword,
            c_1.approved_keyword_norm,
            c_1.approved_at,
            c_1.approved_by,
            c_1.created_at,
            c_1.updated_at,
            row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY c_1.keyword_norm ORDER BY c_1.created_at DESC, c_1.cleanup_id DESC) AS rn
           FROM feya_commerce_seo_keyword_ai_cleanup_v1 c_1
        ), latest_metrics AS (
         SELECT m.snapshot_id,
            m.keyword_norm,
            m.source_api,
            m.geo,
            m.language,
            m.avg_monthly_searches,
            m.competition,
            m.competition_index,
            m.low_top_of_page_bid,
            m.high_top_of_page_bid,
            m.monthly_search_volumes_json,
            m.fetched_at,
            m.raw_payload_json,
            m.data_freshness_status,
            m.created_at,
            row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY m.keyword_norm, m.geo, m.language ORDER BY m.fetched_at DESC, m.snapshot_id DESC) AS rn
           FROM feya_commerce_seo_keyword_metric_snapshots_v1 m
        )
 SELECT c.cleanup_id,
    c.keyword_id,
    c.keyword_norm,
    COALESCE(NULLIF(c.suggested_keyword, ''::text), NULLIF(c.cleaned_keyword, ''::text), c.keyword_norm) AS keyword_for_validation,
    c.original_keyword,
    c.cleaned_keyword,
    c.suggested_keyword,
    c.keyword_axis,
    c.keyword_pattern,
    c.suggested_page_level,
    c.ai_intent,
    c.ai_rewrite_status,
    c.should_validate_api,
    c.should_use_for_product,
    c.should_use_for_collection,
    c.should_use_for_image_alt,
    c.should_hold,
    c.warning_flags,
    c.ai_reason,
    c.review_status,
    COALESCE(lm.geo, 'US'::text) AS metric_geo,
    COALESCE(lm.language, 'en'::text) AS metric_language,
    lm.avg_monthly_searches,
    lm.competition,
    lm.competition_index,
    lm.low_top_of_page_bid,
    lm.high_top_of_page_bid,
    lm.fetched_at AS latest_metric_fetched_at,
        CASE
            WHEN c.should_hold THEN 'hold'::text
            WHEN (c.should_validate_api IS NOT TRUE) THEN 'no_metric_needed'::text
            WHEN (lm.snapshot_id IS NULL) THEN 'needs_metric_import'::text
            WHEN (COALESCE(lm.data_freshness_status, ''::text) = ANY (ARRAY['api_not_connected'::text, 'placeholder'::text, 'mock'::text, 'no_real_metrics'::text])) THEN 'needs_metric_import'::text
            WHEN ((lm.avg_monthly_searches IS NULL) AND (lm.competition IS NULL) AND (lm.competition_index IS NULL)) THEN 'needs_metric_import'::text
            WHEN (lm.fetched_at < (now() - '90 days'::interval)) THEN 'metrics_stale'::text
            ELSE 'has_fresh_metrics'::text
        END AS metric_validation_status,
    c.created_at AS cleanup_created_at,
    c.updated_at AS cleanup_updated_at,
    lm.data_freshness_status AS metric_data_freshness_status
   FROM (latest_cleanup c
     LEFT JOIN latest_metrics lm ON (((lm.keyword_norm = c.keyword_norm) AND (lm.rn = 1))))
  WHERE ((c.rn = 1) AND (c.review_status = ANY (ARRAY['pending'::text, 'needs_review'::text])) AND (c.should_validate_api IS TRUE) AND (c.should_hold IS FALSE));

relations.name: feya_commerce_v_seo_keyword_score_preview_v1
relations.definition:
SELECT keyword_id,
    keyword_for_validation AS keyword,
    keyword_norm,
    keyword_axis,
    keyword_pattern,
    suggested_page_level,
    should_use_for_product,
    should_use_for_collection,
    should_use_for_image_alt,
    avg_monthly_searches,
    competition,
    competition_index,
    low_top_of_page_bid,
    high_top_of_page_bid,
    latest_metric_fetched_at,
        CASE
            WHEN (avg_monthly_searches IS NULL) THEN 'NO_DATA'::text
            WHEN (avg_monthly_searches >= 1000) THEN 'HIGH_DEMAND'::text
            WHEN (avg_monthly_searches >= 100) THEN 'MID_DEMAND'::text
            WHEN (avg_monthly_searches >= 10) THEN 'LOW_DEMAND'::text
            ELSE 'VERY_LOW_DEMAND'::text
        END AS demand_band,
        CASE
            WHEN (competition_index IS NULL) THEN 'UNKNOWN_COMPETITION'::text
            WHEN (competition_index >= (70)::numeric) THEN 'HIGH_COMPETITION'::text
            WHEN (competition_index >= (35)::numeric) THEN 'MID_COMPETITION'::text
            ELSE 'LOW_COMPETITION'::text
        END AS competition_band,
    (((
        CASE
            WHEN (avg_monthly_searches IS NULL) THEN 0
            WHEN (avg_monthly_searches >= 1000) THEN 40
            WHEN (avg_monthly_searches >= 100) THEN 30
            WHEN (avg_monthly_searches >= 10) THEN 15
            ELSE 5
        END +
        CASE
            WHEN (competition_index IS NULL) THEN 0
            WHEN (competition_index < (35)::numeric) THEN 25
            WHEN (competition_index < (70)::numeric) THEN 15
            ELSE 5
        END) +
        CASE
            WHEN (suggested_page_level = 'product'::text) THEN 20
            WHEN (suggested_page_level = 'collection'::text) THEN 15
            WHEN (suggested_page_level = 'image_alt'::text) THEN 5
            ELSE 0
        END) +
        CASE
            WHEN ((high_top_of_page_bid IS NOT NULL) AND (high_top_of_page_bid > (0)::numeric)) THEN 10
            ELSE 0
        END) AS pilot_score,
        CASE
            WHEN (metric_validation_status <> 'has_fresh_metrics'::text) THEN 'WAIT_FOR_METRICS'::text
            WHEN (avg_monthly_searches IS NULL) THEN 'NO_DATA'::text
            WHEN (avg_monthly_searches < 10) THEN 'HOLD_LOW_VOLUME'::text
            WHEN ((suggested_page_level = 'product'::text) AND (avg_monthly_searches >= 10)) THEN 'PRODUCT_CANDIDATE'::text
            WHEN ((suggested_page_level = 'collection'::text) AND (avg_monthly_searches >= 10)) THEN 'COLLECTION_CANDIDATE'::text
            WHEN ((suggested_page_level = 'image_alt'::text) AND (avg_monthly_searches >= 10)) THEN 'IMAGE_ALT_CANDIDATE'::text
            ELSE 'REVIEW'::text
        END AS pilot_recommendation,
    metric_validation_status,
    warning_flags,
    ai_reason
   FROM feya_commerce_v_seo_keyword_metric_validation_queue_v1 q
  WHERE (metric_validation_status = 'has_fresh_metrics'::text);

relations.name: feya_commerce_v_seo_keyword_validation_export_us_en_v1
relations.definition:
WITH ranked_queue AS (
         SELECT q.keyword,
            q.keyword_norm,
            q.priority_tier,
            q.keyword_axis,
            q.keyword_pattern,
            q.product_count,
            q.suggested_page_level,
            q.source,
            'US'::text AS geo,
            'en'::text AS language,
            'us_en_tier1_controlled_150'::text AS batch_code,
            row_number() OVER (ORDER BY q.product_count DESC, q.keyword) AS export_rank
           FROM feya_commerce_v_seo_api_validation_queue_v1 q
          WHERE ((q.priority_tier = 'tier_1'::text) AND (q.requires_api_validation IS TRUE) AND (q.keyword_word_count >= 2) AND (q.validation_priority <> 'low'::text) AND (q.keyword_norm <> ALL (ARRAY['full set'::text, 'whole product'::text, 'choose your set'::text, 'полный комплект'::text])) AND (q.keyword_norm !~ '(^|[^a-z0-9])(xxs|xs|s us|m us|l us|xl|2x|3x|size|размер|буквенный)([^a-z0-9]|$)'::text))
        )
 SELECT keyword,
    keyword_norm,
    priority_tier,
    keyword_axis,
    keyword_pattern,
    product_count,
    suggested_page_level,
    source,
    geo,
    language,
    batch_code,
    export_rank
   FROM ranked_queue
  WHERE (export_rank <= 150);

relations.name: feya_commerce_v_seo_metric_system_status_v1
relations.definition:
SELECT 'cleanup_candidates'::text AS section,
    'needs_human_review'::text AS metric,
    count(*) AS value
   FROM feya_commerce_v_seo_keyword_ai_cleanup_report_v1
  WHERE (feya_commerce_v_seo_keyword_ai_cleanup_report_v1.cleanup_pipeline_status = 'needs_human_review'::text)
UNION ALL
 SELECT 'cleanup_candidates'::text AS section,
    'needs_ai_cleanup'::text AS metric,
    count(*) AS value
   FROM feya_commerce_v_seo_keyword_ai_cleanup_report_v1
  WHERE (feya_commerce_v_seo_keyword_ai_cleanup_report_v1.cleanup_pipeline_status = 'needs_ai_cleanup'::text)
UNION ALL
 SELECT 'metric_validation'::text AS section,
    feya_commerce_v_seo_keyword_metric_validation_queue_v1.metric_validation_status AS metric,
    count(*) AS value
   FROM feya_commerce_v_seo_keyword_metric_validation_queue_v1
  GROUP BY feya_commerce_v_seo_keyword_metric_validation_queue_v1.metric_validation_status
UNION ALL
 SELECT 'metric_import_staging'::text AS section,
    COALESCE(feya_commerce_seo_keyword_metric_import_staging_v1.import_status, 'null_status'::text) AS metric,
    count(*) AS value
   FROM feya_commerce_seo_keyword_metric_import_staging_v1
  GROUP BY COALESCE(feya_commerce_seo_keyword_metric_import_staging_v1.import_status, 'null_status'::text)
UNION ALL
 SELECT 'score_preview'::text AS section,
    'score_ready_rows'::text AS metric,
    count(*) AS value
   FROM feya_commerce_v_seo_keyword_score_preview_v1;
